text.description_html:
Laurey 52404, Transitional Newport Cabinet Cup Pull in Satin Brass

The Satin Brass Newport Cabinet Cup Pull was designed with function and style in mind. This transitional style cabinet bin pull has a rich, Satin Brass finish. The Laurey 52404 3 Inch Pull Newport in Satin Brass comes packaged with the mounting hardware. The use of the Newport Cup Pull on your cabinets will be sure to transform your space into a home.

This transitional cabinet cup pull is part of the Laurey Newport Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 52404 3 Inch Pull Newport Satin Brass:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Satin Brass
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Overall Length: 3-1/2"
  • Width: 1-1/2"
  • Projection: 1.25"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.
